script_links.statement: If the MTL_MUD record is not enabled, this script enables it (_0x480014E54CD33903(MTL_MUD, 1)). The same script references HO_PAR_FRINT.
A value compared with '< 17' selects the variant: the DAY record is enabled when the test is true and the NIGHT record when it is false.
One function disables all five records together (_0x480014E54CD33903(id, 0)) after moving the player.
Two branches on an unnamed argument bind either ROB_BOAT_L_LUCIA or ROB_BOAT_J_JASON to a ped; the LUCIA branch also reads the clock hour.
A stored value compared with 0x88977441 selects AIR_FINAL_DATA_HACK_PASSED or AIR_FINAL_DATA_HACK_FAILED.
The script references both BIL_MOTEL_VIOLENT and BIL_MOTEL_NON_VIOLENT in adjacent branches. The condition that picks one was not decoded.
func_10AD05 returns true when the flag store contains BIL_FINALE_M or BIL_FINAL_B.

Record property 0xDB880157 is read; value 0x4E21D02A is tested against the current player being player_lucia (0xD058819F) and value 0x56D7FE7A against player_jason (0x072B3FF4). A mismatch sets an output flag.
Record properties 0x1FD5BB99 and 0xB376AD2B are read into adjacent fields of one structure.
